Nadia (People Ops): FYI we've pushed Campus Visitor Protocol v2 to the employee guide. New items: condensed 5-min safety ack, host pre-clear rules, and a manager bulk-ack flow. Please complete the ack before next Friday: https://redwood.example.com/campus-visitor-v2 :bookmark_tabs:
Sam (Eng Prod): Does the ack apply to folks who are hybrid and only come once a month?
Nadia (People Ops): Yes — anyone who will be onsite at any Redwood location should complete it. We added a checkbox for "occasional on-site" so hosts can filter.
Vik (Facilities): Note: for events >20 people you'll need to book additional lobby capacity and security. Large-group form here: https://redwood.example.com/large-group-request
Tara (Recruiting): For interview days: can we mark interviewers done ahead of time as a batch? We run several on-site days.
Nadia (People Ops): Yep, manager bulk-ack supports batch by event_id. Recruiting can upload the event CSV and we mark interviewers as complete. Link: https://redwood.example.com/bulk-ack-event
Onboarding Bot: New training assigned (campus_visitor_v2_ack). Due date in 7 days.
Sam (Eng Prod): Any changes around access to prototypes or boardroom whiteboards? We sometimes leave sensitive notes out.
Nadia (People Ops): Protocol clarifies: no sensitive project materials left in public meeting spaces. Hosts must ensure whiteboards cleared and devices locked. If project exposure is unavoidable, get written approval from the project owner and record it in the visitor form.
Vik (Facilities): Can we get an extra column in the export for "expected_guest_count" and "event_id" so we can pre-print badges for panels?
Nadia (People Ops): Added both fields to the weekly export. We'll run exports every Friday at 3pm PT.
Tara (Recruiting): Quick Q: expedited exception for candidates who arrive <24h after scheduling? We sometimes have last-minute onsite accepts.
Nadia (People Ops): Theres an expedite checkbox for last-minute cases; hosts must confirm escort assignment. Expedited exceptions auto-expire in 48h.
Onboarding Bot: Weekly export ready (ts: 1794500600) - required: 156, completed: 124, exemptions: 5, pending: 27. CSV: https://redwood.example.com/exports/1794500600.csv
Tara (Recruiting): I'll chase the remaining interviewers. Thanks.
Sam (Eng Prod): Thanks, will remind my team.
